TASK.r: Root cause: light mode --gold resolves to #7a5800 (dark brown). btn-primary uses color:#0b1426 (near-black). Dark text on dark background = illegible. Fix: added [data-theme="light"] .btn-primary { color:#ffffff } and :hover override. Commit: 9bb964e. Affects all btn-primary instances — Save Record, Save Link, Save Scenario, New SPV, New Company, all modal footers.

NOTES.NOTE: Derived fields (e.g. Deal Size Range from Deal Size) fit naturally in EmergeSchema — store raw value + derived value as separate observed fields. Categorization logic lives in an extension registered via extend(), not in the schema. Logic changes without touching data.

Feature table agreed. Recommend: features(id, name, description, enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0, segment TEXT, release TEXT, created_at). Bitmask on segment column for targeting (internal=1, beta=2, general=4). Toggle with single UPDATE, remove flag with DROP COLUMN after full rollout.

4 Companies → Entities migration noted. EntityType OTHER for non-company portfolio entities is correct. Helper fields with layered logic are the Emerge use case — raw field + derived field + extension that computes derivation. No schema migration needed when logic changes.
